title: Lakeside, Ballinakill, Lettermullen, Co Galway, H91T2K2
seoTitle: Lakeside, Ballinakill, Lettermullen, Co Galway, H91T2K2
description:
DNG Martin O'Connor Estate Agents are delighted to present this exceptional detached waterfront residence 'Lakeside', Ballinakill, Lettermullen, Co. Galway, occupying a peaceful position on the shores of Ballinakill Lough in the heart of Connemara. Enjoying direct frontage onto the lough, together with a private slipway and uninterrupted views across the water, this beautifully maintained home offers a rare opportunity to acquire a distinctive property in one of the West of Ireland's most scenic coastal locations.Extending to approximately 154.3 sq.m. (1,661 sq.ft.), the property has been thoughtfully designed to maximise natural light and take full advantage of its unique surroundings. Beautifully cared for the home offers spacious and well-balanced accommodation throughout. Without doubt, the standout feature of the property is the impressive sunroom, where expansive glazing perfectly frames the peaceful outlook across Ballinakill Lough. Flooded with natural light throughout the day, it provides an exceptional space to relax, entertain or simply enjoy the ever-changing views throughout the seasons.The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, spacious living room, open-plan kitchen and dining area, family bathroom and a generous ground floor double bedroom. At first-floor level there are three further double bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with en suite, together with a well-appointed family bathroom, making the property ideally suited to both family living and those seeking a spacious coastal retreat.Outside, the property is approached through gated entrances onto a spacious tarmac driveway providing excellent parking. Traditional Connemara stone boundary walls, mature gardens and well-maintained grounds create an attractive and private setting around the home. There are three charming stone built outbuildings which further enhances the property's character while providing valuable storage. A private slipway provides direct access to Ballinakill Lough, offering the opportunity to enjoy boating, kayaking, paddle boarding and fishing from your own doorstep.Located in the heart of the Gaeltacht, Lettermullen is renowned for its spectacular coastline, sheltered bays, sandy beaches and rich Irish-speaking heritage. The property is approximately 5.8 km from Lettermore Village and 17.8 km from Carraroe, where a range of shops, cafés, schools and everyday amenities are available. The surrounding area offers an excellent choice of outdoor pursuits, including boating, kayaking, fishing, coastal walks and golf at the nearby Connemara Isles Golf Club. The Seaweed Centre (Ionad na Feamainne), offering seaweed baths, wellness experiences and water-based activities, is also close by, while the surrounding South Connemara coastline and the Wild Atlantic Way provide endless opportunities to explore one of Ireland's most beautiful regions.Whether as a permanent family home, a holiday retreat or a peaceful place to escape, 'Lakeside' offers a wonderful combination of quality accommodation, direct waterfront access and the timeless beauty of Connemara. Properties enjoying lakeside frontage rarely come to the market, making this a unique opportunity to acquire a truly special home in an exceptional coastal setting.To arrange your viewing of this wonderful home please call DNG Martin O'Connor Estate Agents on (091) 866708.
